LESSON: INDIGENOUS KENYAN GAMES

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.6: Indigenous Kenyan Games

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Indigenous Kenyan Games. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is Swimming an essential life skill?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise ways of water entry in the swimming pool
2. appreciate safety in and out of the swimming pool while playing water games

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: INDIGENOUS KENYAN GAMES
This lesson teaches Indigenous Kenyan Games for Grade 4 CREATIVE ARTS.

STUDY STEPS
1. recognise ways of water entry in the swimming pool
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate safety in and out of the swimming pool while playing water games
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Indigenous Kenyan Games using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Indigenous Kenyan Games above.
2. Explain Indigenous Kenyan Games to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Indigenous Kenyan Games.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Indigenous Kenyan Games with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Indigenous Kenyan Games important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is Swimming an essential life skill?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. recognise ways of water entry in the swimming pool
2. appreciate safety in and out of the swimming pool while playing water games

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
